title: Overlapping hour ranges flag red with a message and disable Save
permissions_required: Access to the Edit Location / Edit Staff Member settings screens. Confirm the exact permission live at VIU.
preconditions: 1. You are in the per-day working-hours editor with at least two ranges on one day.
steps: 1. Set two ranges on the same day so their times overlap.
2. Look at the offending range and the Save button.
expected: 1. The offending (overlapping) range is flagged in red.
2. An inline message reads 'These hours overlap. Adjust the times so they don't conflict.'
3. Save is disabled while the overlap exists.
spec_ref: SV-8699 Working Hours Settings (§4.2 - overlap validation)
notes: New-scope from Jira SV-8699 (overlap flagged red + inline message 'These hours overlap. Adjust the times so they don't conflict.' + Save disabled, verbatim). Confirm the exact message + red flag + disabled Save LIVE at VIU (Rule 12). Driver: SV-8699.
